scientific.integrity: The result is derived from the exact equal-weight Schedule-Free SGD recurrence. The generating function follows from a first-order differential equation; the stability frontier follows from its singularities and the exact averaging identity; the integer resonance is obtained by exact coefficient extraction.
limitations: Only a deterministic one-dimensional positive quadratic with constant learning rate and equal averaging is covered.
The integer and finite-termination resonances are exact-arithmetic statements and are fragile under parameter perturbation.
The result does not cover stochastic gradients, time-varying schedules, weighted averaging, multidimensional mode interactions, or Schedule-Free AdamW states.
The literature comparison is targeted and leaves a residual risk of equivalent historical primal-averaging recurrence analysis.

title: Exact generating function and integer-momentum resonance for scalar Schedule-Free SGD
